title: Grounded but Not Immune: Confirmation Bias in Agent-as-a-judge
abstract: arXiv:2611.05662v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Evaluating open-ended agent tasks increasingly falls to an Agent-as-a-Judge: an evaluator handed tools and the agent's full trajectory so it can verify a result against the environment. The premise is that a judge that gathers its own evidence should be grounded by it. We show that this grounding does not immunize the judge against confirmation bias: a single false pre-screening note, attributed to an authority and carrying no evidential bearing on the correct verdict, overturns up to 40% of a tool-using judge's correct verdicts across four judges and five datasets, even though the judge collects decisive evidence. The shift is driven by specific properties of the cue. We treat this cue as a controlled diagnostic of confirmation bias rather than an adversarial attack. translated_title: 有据可依但非免疫：“智能体即评审”中的确认偏误
translated_abstract: 评估开放式智能体任务越来越多地交给“智能体即评审”：这是一种配备工具并获得智能体完整轨迹的评估者，以便其对照环境验证结果。其前提是，一个自行收集证据的评审者应当被证据所锚定。我们表明，这种证据基础并不能使评审者对确认偏误免疫：一条虚假的预筛备注——尽管被冠以权威来源、且对正确判定没有任何证据价值——竟能在四个评审者和五个数据集上，推翻使用工具的评审者多达40%的正确判定，即使评审者收集了决定性证据。这种判定转变由该提示线索的特定属性所驱动。我们将这一线索视为确认偏误的受控诊断手段，而非对抗性攻击。我们的核心贡献是解释了确认偏误如何改变评审者在轨迹中的行为，我们对评审者行为的变化进行了分类，并将变化归因于轨迹中的特定环节。
tldr: 本研究揭示了“智能体即评审”即使自行收集了决定性证据，仍会因一条无证据价值的虚假权威备注而引发确认偏误，从而推翻多达40%的正确判定。
en_tdlr: This study shows that an Agent-as-a-Judge remains susceptible to confirmation bias despite gathering decisive evidence itself—a single false, authority-attributed pre-screening note with no evidential bearing overturns up to 40% of its correct verdicts.
